value.rationale: The source itself singles out the extension past the twelfth moment as a live but unoptimized quantitative direction. The exact crossing 12+832/5227 converts that qualitative statement into a reproducible unconditional interval of improved moment exponents, extending the record exponent range by about 0.159 beyond 12. The endpoint is mathematically natural: it is where the source proof's controlling middle-range affine exponent meets the classical interpolation line.
